name: B10-0381/2025 (PfE) – Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine and the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text:
This text is a statement of the European Parliament's position, not a change in law. It calls for all hostages held in Gaza to be freed at once, living and dead. It supports aid entering Gaza through the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation and says aid must reach civilians, not armed groups. It says Hamas must have no future role in Gaza and that recognising a Palestinian state now is inappropriate.

- The text asks for hostages' release and continued aid; nothing changes in law.
- It concerns hostages, Gaza civilians, Hamas, aid groups and EU member states.
- It is sent to EU leaders and to Israel and the Palestinian Authority; no binding action follows.
